verdict.rationale: Carta's evidence documents an API with OAuth client-credentials access, a data warehouse, and Claude MCP plugins for natural-language queries. None of it describes a product feature for setting up automations, schedules, or background agents that run on their own. The API and client-credentials flow are developer building blocks a user could build automation on, and the MCP plugins are interactive, so neither counts as product-native background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
